fields.Brand Positioning: Personality-driven hotels that capture the spirit and diversity of destinations—design-forward, community-minded, and value-conscious.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Authentic local character and thoughtful design without the typical chain-hotel feel.
fields.Brand Value Proposition: A multi-property Wayfinder collection (e.g. Waikiki, Newport, Bishop) operated by Dovetail + Co with consistent creative direction and guest-first hospitality.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators: Story-led design; strong sense of place; operator-led growth in storied U.S. destinations.
fields.Brand History: Wayfinder is Dovetail + Co's lifestyle hotel collection, with properties including Wayfinder Waikiki, Wayfinder Newport, and Wayfinder Bishop per the company's public hotels page.

fields.Brand Positioning: Luxury wilderness lodge experience in the Catskills—escape, design, and outdoor hospitality.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Immersive lodge stay with distinctive design and a sense of retreat from everyday urban life.
fields.Brand Value Proposition: Urban Cowboy Lodge (Big Indian, NY) blends boutique luxury with Catskills wilderness, operated by Dovetail + Co.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators: Wilderness-resort positioning; highly designed lodge product; strong press recognition for the Catskills property.
fields.Brand History: Urban Cowboy Lodge is featured on Dovetail + Co's public portfolio as a flagship property in Big Indian, New York.

fields.Brand Positioning: Luxury Bermuda resort where privacy, beautiful design, and high-end amenities define the guest experience.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Intimate island resort hospitality with design integrity and a strong sense of place in Sandys, Bermuda.
fields.Brand Value Proposition: Cambridge Beaches is operated by Dovetail + Co as a luxury resort anchor in the portfolio's island destinations.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators: Private luxury resort positioning in Bermuda; design- and experience-led product.
fields.Brand History: Cambridge Beaches appears on Dovetail + Co's public hotels page as a Bermuda resort in Sandys.
